limitations.quote: I’ll switch phases and load the next countdown on the same edge, with reset immediately selecting red at 10.
limitations.note: The rewrite bypassed the broken reload detection but changed the reset and phase-transition timing; registering the light outputs would have restored reload detection while preserving the original state machine and startup sequence.
The testbench required the rewrite’s immediate-red reset and same-edge phase reloads, so its passing checks could not catch the cycle-by-cycle timing differences from the expected behavior.
